person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and narrates Rapp, Kennedy, Simon, Neville, and other characters in third person. The long event quotations expose sustained third-person scenes from multiple parts of the novel, while q01960 is local dialogue, q01957’s “you” is a generic hypothetical, and the shortest fragments are nondiagnostic. Two sustained web samples independently confirm third-person narration across the opening Kennedy material and Chapter 1. Although no explicit whole-book POV analysis was found and the web excerpts are opening-scoped, the interior Goodreads scenes corroborate the same person and reveal no credible first-, second-, or alternating-person base narration.
